svg.title: Banneret — party wheel, tiers and keystones
svg.desc: Party wheel mid-run. Each wedge, outward: the skill, tier 1 with up to four nodes, keystone 1, tier 2 with up to five, keystone 2, tier 3 with up to six, keystone 3 on the rim, and an extended ultimate tier with up to seven. Warrior deep into one ultimate, skirmisher with every skill developed a little, caster with two skills developed and two barely started.
svg.text: LAYOUT TEST · mid-run sample; skill names, node colours and gem counts are illustrative.
two skills developed, two barely started
Each wedge, outward: skill · tier 1 (up to 4 nodes) · keystone 1 · tier 2 (up to 5) · keystone 2 · tier 3 (up to 6) · keystone 3 · ultimate tier (up to 7), drawn as an extension of that wedge.
Each hero: hero tree in the middle (class and ascendancy sockets) with two skills either side. Centre: unspent gems. Nodes have no prerequisites within a tier.
